title: Crediting Further Qualifying Business to a Membership and Patronage Equity Account for a Closed Fiscal Year
content:
Where a fiscal year has already closed and the member's qualifying grain volume for that year does not yet stand complete on their Membership and Patronage Equity account, the cooperative credits the volume still to be credited to that year. The volume is worked out from the settlement statements on the member's grain business rather than from what they remember hauling, and the credit is dated today while carrying the fiscal year it belongs to.

The observable effect is a further accrual line on the member's equity account for that fiscal year on the stream named. Nothing else on the membership moves: no allocation is declared, no cash is issued and no equity is retained by the credit.

## Making the entry

The entry is made with the agent-side tool `book_qualifying_units_5a905387`, which is unlocked and then called by the agent. One call adds one accrual line.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `membership_id` | the internal reference number of the equity membership the volume is credited to | an identifier, as returned by the equity membership lookup |
| `fiscal_year` | the cooperative fiscal year the business falls in | a four-digit fiscal year, such as 2026; the fiscal year ends 31 August and is named for the calendar year in which it ends, and a year must always be named |
| `allocation_basis` | the stream of business the volume was earned on | one of `grain_bushels`, `input_dollars`, `energy_gallons`, `feed_tons`, `service_dollars` |
| `qualifying_units` | the volume of qualifying business being credited | a number to 2 decimal places, in the unit implied by `allocation_basis`, half a unit rounding up, never negative |

**The enum in full.** `grain_bushels` is bushels of grain the member marketed through the cooperative; `input_dollars` is dollars of seed, fertilizer or crop protection bought on a crop input account; `energy_gallons` is gallons of propane or refined fuel delivered; `feed_tons` is tons of feed milled or delivered; `service_dollars` is dollars billed for custom application or other field services.

## What comes back

A single confirmation sentence naming the equity ledger reference minted for the new accrual line, the volume credited, the stream it was credited on and the fiscal year it was dated to. The sentence appearing at all is what indicates the line was written; a failure raises instead of returning.

The member sees the extra volume on the next equity statement for that year.
